mapper.select: SELECT icam01_info_cd AS infoCode , icam01_info_nm AS infoName , icam01_tr_cd AS trCode , icam01_tr_nm AS trName , icam01_ics_class_tree_id AS icsClassTreeId , icam01_note AS note FROM icam01_data_info LEFT OUTER JOIN ics01_class_tree ON icam01_ics_class_tree_id = ics01_class_tree_id WHERE icam01_info_cd = #{infoCode} AND icam01_tr_cd = #{trCode}
